included: Measured RCC, reinforcement and formwork; wall masonry and plaster
Room flooring, wet-room tiles, doors, frames, glazing and paint
Configured kitchen, sanitary, electrical and storage allowances
Planned exterior works and enabled extras; separate approvals and connection allowances
excluded: Land purchase, finance, movable furniture and loose appliances
Engineered piles, raft, retaining walls or special soil remediation
Unmeasured Blender facade features, pitched roof structure and tank civil support
Product waste and service runs beyond documented allowances; taxes on professional fees
notes: Concrete includes cement, sand and aggregate. Cement bags are an informational material take-off, not an additional charge. Nominal M20 quantities do not prescribe an M25/M30 mix.

Internal/external plaster partition uses source exterior wall faces and parapets. Interior room paint is allocated by measured wall-face weights after wet-tile deductions; site and ceiling measures are separate.
Piping, wiring, kitchen runs, cladding and shade projections are configurable concept allowances; confirm coordinated working drawings before procurement.
Trade shares use direct works only. GST, when enabled, applies to works + overhead + contingency; fees and authority allowances are excluded from this provisional GST base.
Turnkey includes measured materials and labour plus overhead. Material + labour is the same scope split for owner procurement, not a different project total.
Default comparison uses this finish preset without finish overrides, with the same measured geometry and technical sizing. Rates are provisional, not verified current contractor quotes.

Sanity bands are provisional full-project checks including measured member works, configured finishes/site scope, overhead, fees, contingency and approvals/connections. Basic/Mid upper bounds replace narrower legacy area-allowance bands; unusual extras or small floor areas can legitimately fall outside them.
